description: Nested view resolution — view_a references view_b which references base table
source_sql: REPLACE VIEW work_db.base_accounts_v AS SELECT acct.account_id, acct.account_name, acct.status FROM s_acctdb.account_master acct WHERE acct.status != 'CLOSED';
REPLACE VIEW work_db.active_accounts_v AS SELECT bav.account_id, bav.account_name FROM work_db.base_accounts_v bav WHERE bav.status = 'ACTIVE';
SELECT aav.account_id, aav.account_name, tx.total_amount FROM work_db.active_accounts_v aav INNER JOIN e_txndb.transaction_summary tx ON aav.account_id = tx.account_id;
